lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular local maxima arranged in roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, creating a rectangular grid-like distribution posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with and intersect the high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition from high-density micro-blobs on the anterior cranial region to lower-density macro-blobs on the posterior flank.
